item.title: Derry gets past Elizabeth Forward in tense finale to win 1st section title in 69 years
item.description: Entering Friday night’s contest between Elizabeth Forward and Derry, both squads knew the stakes of their matchup.

item.title: Ace Bartenders owners purchase The Club at Blackthorne for $3.9M amid zoning dispute
item.description: The future of a planned restaurant within Penn Township’s Blackthorne Estates hinges on an upcoming zoning meeting, as new ownership faces a formal challenge from developers over the facility’s use.

item.title: Letter to the editor: What violent crimes did apprehended children commit?
item.description: I agree that violent criminals who are here illegally should be deported. My question is: What violent crimes did 5-year-old Liam Conejo Ramos and the 2-year-old daughter of Elvis Tipan-Echeverria commit? Rape? Robbery? Murder? Sexual abuse of a minor? Serious assault? Domestic violence? Stalking? Child abuse? Weapons trafficking? Trafficking controlled substances?

item.title: ‘The love is still here’: Record search reveals Greensburg couple’s 75th anniversary is their 74th
item.description: Greensburg couple Ed and Sally Wagner have been together so long they forgot the year they were married.

item.title: Minor league report: Matt Dumba’s hat trick leads Penguins past Phantoms
item.description: Defenseman Matt Dumba recorded his first career hat trick as a professional as well as an assist for the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins in a 6-5 win against the rival Lehigh Valley Phantoms at the PPL Center in Allentown on Friday.

item.title: WPIAL clinched: Boys basketball playoff qualifiers through Feb. 6, 2026
item.description: One day remains in the stretch run as the WPIAL boys basketball playoff field is up to 86 teams that have clinched district postseason berths. Three more teams could join them Saturday.

item.title: WPIAL clinched: Girls basketball playoff qualifiers through Feb. 6, 2026
item.description: The WPIAL girls basketball regular season is down to a few games as the district playoff field is nearly finalized with 80 teams ready to participate in the February Frenzy. An 81st team could join them Saturday.

item.title: Moon gets past Montour in OT in hard-fought regular-season finale
item.description: AJ Buford’s layup with seconds remaining in overtime lifted Moon to a dramatic 48-45 win over Montour on the Spartans’ senior night Friday.

item.title: High school roundup for Feb. 6, 2026: Greensburg Salem rallies from double-digit deficit in 4th quarter to clinch playoff spot
item.description: Ty Harkcom scored 21 points and Greensburg Salem rallied from an 11-point fourth-quarter deficit to beat West Mifflin, 51-40, and clinch a playoff spot in Section 3-4A boys basketball Friday night.
